items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So Schiffman came down the Le Ruban Bleu and asked me if I would be interested in playing at the Apollo Theater.

ctx.x: I had a personal run-in with Schiffman, because after Kirby and I were separated and divorced, Kirby was going in his direction and I in mine. And I happened to have been appearing at Le Ruban Bleu in New York, and I hadn't appeared at the Apollo for quite some time. So Schiffman came down the Le Ruban Bleu and asked me if I would be interested in playing at the Apollo Theater. And I told him yeah, but there was a stipulation. I mentioned the fact that under no circumstances did I want to appear at the Apollo
